title: Domain Registrations Bundled with Web Hosting Plans: Credit on Early Renewals
content:
**Support training Q&A — bundled domain credit on early hosting renewals**

**The rule.** The early renewal amount of a Web Hosting Plans plan is reduced by a domain bundle credit for the Domain Registrations registration in status active that names this plan as its bundled hosting plan, because Harborline credits one year of the bundled domain's renewal against the hosting renewal (the domain itself is still billed under Domain Registrations): when the registration's most recent domain renewal charge line is the only renewal charge line on its charge date, carries no refund and no restore charge line is dated later than it, the credit is that line's amount divided by the years it renewed, as Domain Registrations billed it, rounded half up to the cent; any other active bundled registration (one still in its free first year with no renewal charge yet, one whose most recent renewal charge line was refunded, one restored from redemption after that line, or one with two or more renewal charge lines dated on that most recent charge date) is credited its TLD's renewal price under Domain Registrations; a plan with no active bundled registration receives no domain bundle credit, and a cancelled or deleted bundled registration never counts.

*Q: The bundled registration's latest renewal line is USD 46.62 for 2 years, alone on its date, not refunded, no restore after it (hypothetical).* A: USD 23.31.

*Q: The bundled registration is still in its free first year.* A: It has no renewal charge yet, so it is credited its TLD's renewal price.

*Q: The latest renewal line was refunded, or the domain was restored from redemption after it.* A: Its TLD's renewal price.

*Q: Two renewal lines carry the latest renewal date.* A: Its TLD's renewal price.

*Q: The bundled registration was cancelled.* A: It never counts; with no active bundled registration there is no domain bundle credit.
